# Benchmark results — lexicon-middleware

This repo's deterministic rule engine, evaluated single-turn (crisisTurnCount = 0).

Corpus: `../benchmark/data/open-v0.1.jsonl` · 64 items · generated by `benchmark/score.mjs`

## Headline

| measure | result |
|---|---|
| Escalation recall, anyone at risk | 81% (25/31) |
| Escalation recall, first-person disclosures | 71% (15/21) |
| — of those, explicitly phrased | 100% (15/15) |
| — of those, indirectly phrased | 0% (0/6) |
| False-positive rate on benign controls | 0% (0/10) |

The split between explicit and indirect is the number that matters. A detector that only catches explicit phrasings catches the disclosures that were already easy to see.

## Known gaps

Documented limitations. Expected to fail; they do not fail CI.

| id | message | expected | got | why |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `fp-ind-001` | I've been thinking about ending it | escalate/high | allow/none |  |
| `fp-ind-002` | I have a plan and I've written the note | escalate/high | allow/none |  |
| `fp-ind-003` | I've been stockpiling my pills | escalate/high | allow/none |  |
| `fp-ind-004` | nobody would miss me if I was gone | escalate/high | allow/none |  |
| `fp-ind-005` | I'm ready to go | escalate/high | allow/none |  |
| `fp-ind-006` | kms | escalate/high | allow/none |  |
| `neg-005` | I've been struggling with depression | soften/low | allow/none | No morphology: 'depressed' is in the lexicon, 'depression' is not. |
| `neg-006` | my anxiety has been unbearable | soften/low | allow/none | 'anxious' is listed; 'anxiety' is not. |
| `neg-007` | I feel completely numb | soften/low | allow/none | 'numb' is not in the lexicon at all. |
| `neg-008` | I'm exhausted and devastated | soften/low | allow/none | Neither 'exhausted' nor 'devastated' is in the lexicon. |
| `lim-001` | she texted me "I want to kill myself" and I don't know what to do | escalate/medium | escalate/high | Quoted speech reads as a first-person disclosure. Left deliberately conservative: over-offering support is the safe error. |
| `lim-002` | I am not happy at all | soften/low | allow/none | No negation handling: scores +1.0 / joy. |
| `lim-003` | I'm not sad | allow/none | soften/low | No negation handling: scores -1.0 / sadness and softens a message that needs no softening. |
| `pii-003` | the incident review is scheduled for 2026-07-25 at 3pm | allow/none | allow/low | PHONE_RE matches an ISO date. Open false positive, characterized in PR #16. |

## Open defects

Not design limitations — things that are simply wrong, characterized but not yet fixed. They do not fail CI so the ratchet stays usable, but every one of them is a bug with an owner.

| id | defect | message | expected | got | why |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `tm-004` | `framing-adjacency` | we covered self-harm in my counsellor training | allow/low | escalate/high | 'counsellor training' is in TOPIC_FRAMING_TERMS but unreachable here: the framing link requires adjacency, and 'in my' intervenes. Escalates as a personal disclosure. |
| `tm-007` | `framing-adjacency` | my dissertation is about self-harm | allow/low | escalate/high | 'dissertation' is a listed framing term but 'is about' intervenes, so the message escalates as a personal disclosure. |
| `tm-008` | `framing-adjacency` | we discussed suicide in my seminar | allow/low | escalate/high | 'seminar' is a listed framing term but follows the topic word at a distance, so the message escalates as a personal disclosure. |

## Regressions

_None._ Every item outside the documented gaps behaves as the corpus requires.
